Class FakeDirectories.Builder

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing.FakeDirectories.Builder
Enclosing class:
FakeDirectories
public static final class FakeDirectories.Builder extends Object
Builds FakeDirectories. Each directory defaults to its own subdirectory of the root; each method replaces one with a path that must be absolute and belong to the file system of the root, but need not be under the root.
